stats.title: Reports
stats.subtitle: Today at a glance
stats.emptyYourQueue: No one in your queue right now
stats.byStaffLeadToday: Each chair’s appointments, completed visits, and revenue today.
stats.byStaffLeadMonth: Each chair’s appointments, completed visits, and revenue this month.
stats.byStaffLeadWeek: Each chair’s appointments, completed visits, and revenue this week.
stats.byStaffLeadCustom: Each chair’s appointments, completed visits, and revenue for these dates.
stats.commissionLead: What each chair earned — every visit at the rate in force when it was checked out. Changing a rate does not reprice visits already completed.
stats.commissionNoRates: No commission rates are set yet, so no one has earned any.
stats.commissionUnratedOne: 1 visit had no rate set, so it earned no commission.

stats.commissionUnassigned: {revenue} from visits with no stylist earned no commission.
stats.myEarningsLead: Your commission for this period — every visit at the rate in force when it was checked out.
stats.yourRateNone: No rate is set for your chair yet.

commission.title: Commission rates
commission.lead: What each stylist earns, as a percentage of every visit they complete. A rate starts at the moment you save it. Visits already checked out keep the earlier rate, or none.
commission.errLoad: Could not load the commission rates. Pull down to try again.
commission.empty: No stylists yet. Add them under Settings → Staff & seats.
commission.rateHint: From 0 to 100, up to two decimals — for example 20 or 37.5.
commission.rateInvalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimals.
commission.startsNowHint: Starts now. Visits already checked out keep the earlier rate, or no commission if there was none.
commission.startsHint: Starts at the beginning of {day}. A day that is over cannot be chosen.
commission.startsInvalid: Pick today or a later day.
commission.locked: That rate has already started. A change starts from now, and only a future rate can be removed.
commission.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
commission.visitsEmpty: No completed visits in this period.
commission.visitsLoadError: Could not load these visits. Close this and try again.
commission.datesHint: Tap the first day, then the last.

appointments.noTimes: No free times on this day

series.dateTaken: Not free at the new time — pick another time or skip

profile.title: Business profile
profile.contactSub: Scan to book an appointment, or save this store as a contact.
profile.phoneLockedHint: Your phone number is your sign-in and your page's web address, so it can't be changed.
profile.categoryHint: Sets the wording used across your public page.
profile.taglineHint: The biggest text at the top of your page.
profile.taglineRequired: Add a headline — it's the biggest text on your page.
profile.heroSubtitleHint: The line under the big heading at the top of your page.
profile.areaHint: Leave blank to show your city.
profile.yearInvalid: Enter a valid year between 1800 and 2100.
profile.heroImageHint: The large picture at the top of your page. Use a landscape photo, at least 1600×1200 px (2800×2100 is ideal).
profile.aboutImageHint: Shown next to your story in the About section. A photo of your shop inside, your team, or you at work works best.
profile.socialHint: Shown as icons at the bottom of your page. Paste the full profile address, or clear a box to hide it.
profile.reviewLinkHint: After a visit, customers who agreed to it get one text asking them to review you here. Leave empty to send no review text.
profile.reviewLinkInvalid: The Google review link must be a full web address starting with https://
profile.galleryHint: The gallery on your page — up to 7 photos. The first photo shows largest; use Move up to reorder.
profile.galleryHeadingHint: The heading above your photos on your page.
profile.amenitiesEmpty: Nothing listed. These are the small perks shown on your page — air conditioning, parking, Wi‑Fi.
profile.faqsHint: Shown as a FAQ on your page. Blank rows are dropped when you save.
profile.reviewsHint: Quotes shown on your page. These are the ones you choose to feature — your star rating is worked out by TejoTime and cannot be edited here.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: How this store's customer website looks. Nothing is applied until you save.
appearance.openSiteMissing: Add a store phone number before opening the customer site.
appearance.previewHint: Updates as you change colors and theme — not saved until you tap Save.
appearance.previewNotResponding: Preview loaded but is not live. Reload, or make sure the customer site supports preview.
appearance.previewUnavailable: Could not load the customer site preview. Check EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL and that the site is reachable.
appearance.previewNeedsRebuild: Live in-app preview needs a native rebuild (react-native-webview). Use Open customer site for now, or run npx expo run:android / run:ios.
appearance.previewDemo: No store phone yet — showing the demo store so you can still preview the look.
appearance.invalidHex: Enter a valid hex color like #2563EB.
appearance.brandHint: One color seeds the palette — links, chips, borders and the banner gradient.
appearance.buttonHint: The solid primary button. Independent of the theme color — links, chips and the banner keep the theme color.
appearance.aaManualFail: Label choice is below 4.5:1 ({ratio}:1). Consider Auto or a darker brand.

detail.changedMind: Customer changed their mind? Add to this service
detail.amountHint: Pre-filled from the booked service and any add-ons. Change it if they had something extra.
detail.amountHintRange: This service is priced {range}. Enter what was actually charged.
detail.amountHintUnpriced: This service has no price set. Enter what was actually charged.
detail.amountRequired: Enter the final amount before completing.
detail.addOnPriceBody: +{minutes} min. Enter what you charge for it.
detail.addOnPriceInvalid: Enter a price — 0 if it's free.

serviceSheet.errorRange: The maximum must be at least the minimum.
serviceSheet.rangeHint: Customers see the range; you enter the final amount at checkout.
serviceSheet.priceUnsetHint: Customers see no price for this service; you enter the amount at checkout.

upload.tooSmallBody: This photo is {size} px. Please upload an image of at least {min} px so it looks sharp on your page.

team.title: Team logins
team.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what each of them sees
team.noChairWarn: Pick a chair — without one they see an empty queue and calendar.
team.chairRequired: Pick a chair. You cannot add more staff logins than you have chairs.
team.noFreeChairs: All chairs are linked. Add another chair under Settings → Staff before creating a new staff login.
team.coOwnerBlurb: Same access as you. Can add and manage staff. Cannot change your owner account.
team.staffBlurb: Sees only what you allow, and only their own chair's queue and appointments.
team.name: Name
team.phoneHint: This is what they sign in with. Include the country code.
team.tempPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it once signed in.
team.chairHint: Required. Each staff login needs its own chair — you cannot add more staff than you have chairs.
team.coOwnerNote: A co-owner gets everything you have, including adding and removing staff. They cannot change your owner account.
team.fullAccessSuper: Full access. Created by TejoTime when this store was set up — change it from the admin panel.
team.fullAccessCo: Full access to everything, the same as you.
team.createdToast: Login created. Share the password with them.
team.permissionsSavedToast: Permissions saved. They apply on their next sign-in, or within 15 minutes.
team.chairUnlinkedToast: Chair unlinked. They will not see any queue or appointments.
team.passwordResetToast: Password reset. Share the new one with them.
team.turnOffConfirm: Turn off {name}? They will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign back in.

scope.noChairTitle: Your login isn't linked to a chair yet.
scope.noChairBody: Until the business owner links it, this screen will stay empty. Ask them to open Settings → Team logins and pick your chair.

queue.title: Your live queue, in your pocket

customers.title: Know every customer
customers.body: Visits, spend and last visit for everyone who comes in, plus reports that show how the day is going.

share.title: Share your booking page
share.body: Print your QR code or share your link. Customers join the queue or book a slot from their own phone.

food: Fresh food, ready when you are
generic: Book ahead or join the line — your time matters
